title: M7.P5: Keep host regression compilers and patches in owned scratch
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

All host gcc/cc/patch sites now use owned scratch while guest namespaces keep private /tmp. Ten focused controls and final exact-source scripts proof02 pass:1378PASS/0FAIL/0SKIP. Source51ddf40833 is delivered; original seven QA20 failures remain. See [regression and acceptance controls](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-regression-fixtures). The initial final-evidence commit also failed safely on quota-full /tmp; the normal hook passed with owned TMPDIR, without a bypass.

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

Owner requirement: “Let's fix any caps we discover before we generate a new build.” Clarification: “Also, my last message said, "any caps we…" but I meant "any gaps"”.

Parent: #344; M7.P5. Found during corrected replacement20 qualification. Original QA20 results remain unchanged.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — disposable host/namespace fixtures exercise the QA harness and its current-boot guest protocol. No owner device or cloud action is needed.

## Current behavior and code trace
`tools/last-good-scripts-test` unsets TMPDIR to protect bubblewrap guests. Several host gcc/cc and patch commands subsequently fall back to quota-full host /tmp. QA20 records actual sharp-face, append-slot, browser URI and WebKit patch failures. #541 scoped two patch calls and final Python helpers but omitted these host calls.
Already written: only disposable host test files and failed logs; no device or cloud state. Preserve originals and rerun corrected tooling against the same frozen product source.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Actual host compiler and patch controls fail with unusable scratch and pass with owned scratch; a bubblewrap device fixture still uses its private /tmp, with a recorded log.
- [x] All host compiler/patch invocations in this harness use owned scratch; the full corrected frozen-source regression run has zero failures and zero skips, with original QA20 failures retained.
- [x] Source, work/friction log and compact proof are delivered; exact-source checks pass.
